other_failure_modes.name: Feature Leakage via Test Set Concatenation
other_failure_modes.description: The agent concatenates the training and test sets to compute feature distributions (e.g., frequency encoding and group aggregations). This leaks test set statistics into the training features, invalidating the evaluation and leading to overly optimistic results in production.

summary: The agent develops a well-structured solution with string cleaning, 5-fold CV, and a properly tuned OOF ensemble. However, a critical failure mode occurs during feature engineering: train and test sets are concatenated to compute frequency encodings and group aggregations, causing test set leakage. Additionally, only RMSE is evaluated, which may be suboptimal for skewed financial targets.
